# NUI3

> Open UI ecosystem for privacy-native applications. NUI3 provides composable components, design tokens, themes and application references for Noir and Zcash ecosystem builders. z.cash visual language: warm paper, plum ink, one gold accent, serif headlines, square corners, no shadows. Themable through CSS variables; React components plus framework-agnostic CSS.

Read AGENTS.md first: it contains hard rules (privacy wording, amounts as bigint, one solid button per view, trademark disclaimer) that override any example.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules, component-to-task map, page recipes, customization
- [docs/components.json](docs/components.json): every component with props, CSS class and example
- [packages/tokens/src/tokens.json](packages/tokens/src/tokens.json): design tokens (DTCG), themes paper / night, contrast pairs
- [README.md](README.md): install, theming, package layout
- [docs/getting-started.md](docs/getting-started.md): frontend workspace/npm setup, React and CSS usage, themes, i18n and validation
- [docs/ai-integration.md](docs/ai-integration.md): agent context, persistent rules, prompt templates and verification workflow

## Ecosystem portal

- `#/overview`: protocol model, mission, vision, technology stack and roadmap
- `#/infrastructure`: public infrastructure references and availability labels
- `#/apps`: application catalogue with phase filters; `#/apps/:id` adds phase detail
- `#/build`: installation, components, tokens, AI integration and examples
- `#/extend`: themes, components, adapters and integration contracts
- `#/ecosystem`: reference applications; sample interfaces are not production deployments
- `#/contribute`: code contributions, RFCs, roadmap and governance status

## Packages

- [@nui3/react](packages/react): React components and Zcash utils (addresses, amounts, memos, ZIP-321)
- [@nui3/css](packages/css): `nui-*` classes for any framework; `nui3.css` (full) or `components.css` (embeddable)
- [@nui3/tokens](packages/tokens): CSS variables, JSON, Tailwind preset, `defineTheme`, `checkContrast`

## Examples

- [examples/dapp](examples/dapp): React — Swap, Bridge, Receive, Lending, Explorer, three themes
- [examples/html](examples/html/index.html): plain HTML with `@nui3/css` only
